Backed by a team of experienced professionals, Narim Multiventures combines technical excellence, responsive support, and quality products to deliver reliable solutions that meet the evolving needs of its customers.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Technical Analyst (Chemist)

Job Location: Anthony Village, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities


	Receive, label, and prepare samples for laboratory analysis.
	Perform routine and specialized chemical analyses using approved test methods.
	Conduct laboratory testing on water, wastewater, food, industrial products, and other environmental samples as assigned.
	Prepare reagents, standard solutions, and calibration standards.
	Operate, calibrate, and maintain laboratory instruments and analytical equipment.
	Record, interpret, and report analytical results accurately and within specified turnaround times.

	Participate in method validation, verification, and quality control activities.
	Maintain accurate laboratory records, worksheets, and test reports.
	Monitor laboratory inventory and communicate reagent and consumable requirements.
	Ensure proper housekeeping and safe handling, storage, and disposal of laboratory chemicals and wastes.
	Support internal audits, external audits, and accreditation activities.


Requirements


	Minimum of a B.Sc. or HND in Industrial Chemistry.
	1&ndash;3 years of laboratory experience in an environmental, industrial, research, or quality control laboratory.
	Post-degree qualifications are highly preferred
	Candidates with Degrees in Chemistry, Applied Chemistry, or closely related disciplines may also be considered; however, Industrial Chemistry is highly preferred.
	Experience in an ISO/IEC 17025-accredited laboratory is an added advantage.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: hr@narimultiventures.com using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.",

Technical Analyst (Chemist) Job at Narim Multiventures Nigeria Limited




        
    

        
        Narim Multiventures Nigeria Limited is a leading provider of water and wastewater treatment solutions, delivering cost-effective, innovative, and customized services to industrial, commercial, and institutional clients across Nigeria. With expertise in water treatment, industrial specialty chemicals, environmental services, and process optimization, the company is committed to helping clients improve operational efficiency while ensuring regulatory compliance and environmental sustainability.

Backed by a team of experienced professionals, Narim Multiventures combines technical excellence, responsive support, and quality products to deliver reliable solutions that meet the evolving needs of its customers.
     

            
    



We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Technical Analyst (Chemist)

Job Location: Anthony Village, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities


	Receive, label, and prepare samples for laboratory analysis.
	Perform routine and specialized chemical analyses using approved test methods.
	Conduct laboratory testing on water, wastewater, food, industrial products, and other environmental samples as assigned.
	Prepare reagents, standard solutions, and calibration standards.
	Operate, calibrate, and maintain laboratory instruments and analytical equipment.
	Record, interpret, and report analytical results accurately and within specified turnaround times.
	Ensure compliance with ISO/IEC 17025 requirements, laboratory quality procedures, and standard operating procedures.
	Participate in method validation, verification, and quality control activities.
	Maintain accurate laboratory records, worksheets, and test reports.
	Monitor laboratory inventory and communicate reagent and consumable requirements.
	Ensure proper housekeeping and safe handling, storage, and disposal of laboratory chemicals and wastes.
	Support internal audits, external audits, and accreditation activities.


Requirements


	Minimum of a B.Sc. or HND in Industrial Chemistry.
	1–3 years of laboratory experience in an environmental, industrial, research, or quality control laboratory.
	Post-degree qualifications are highly preferred
	Candidates with Degrees in Chemistry, Applied Chemistry, or closely related disciplines may also be considered; however, Industrial Chemistry is highly preferred.
	Experience in an ISO/IEC 17025-accredited laboratory is an added advantage.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Web Designer Job at Kojo Auto Service Center Limited




        
    

        
        Kojo Auto Service Centre Limited is an automotive service organization providing vehicle maintenance, diagnostics, mechanical repairs electrical repairs, AC overhaul, body and painting, tyre services, car wash, spare parts sales, and customer support services.

We are recruiting to fill the position below: 

 Job Position:  Web Designer

Job Location: Abuja (FCT)
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Design, develop, and maintain the company's website.
	Regularly update website content, features, and functionalities.
	Ensure the website is secure, responsive, and user-friendly.
	Troubleshoot website issues and resolve them promptly.
	Monitor website performance and recommend improvements.
	Optimize websites for SEO and improve user experience.
	Integrate new tools, features, and digital solutions to enhance our online presence.


Who We're Looking For


	Tech-Savvy & Curious – You don't just use tools; you master them. You stay ahead of design trends and enjoy experimenting with new digital tools, AI integrations, and frameworks.
	A Sharp Problem Solver – When a page breaks or a link goes down, you don't panic. You enjoy troubleshooting and fixing issues quickly.
	Highly Adaptable – You bring fresh ideas, positive energy, and have a high learning agility.
	Detail-Oriented – You notice even the smallest design inconsistencies and care deeply about clean backend organization.


Technical Skills Required:


	Proficiency with modern design and prototyping tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, and Photoshop.
	Solid experience with CMS platforms such as WordPress, Webflow, and Shopify.
	Strong foundational knowledge of HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript.
	Familiarity with website analytics (Google Analytics) and SEO fundamentals.
	Experience with hosting environments and website maintenance.


Why Join Us


	Work with a dynamic and innovative team.
	Opportunity to grow and learn new technologies.
	Contribute to exciting digital projects and make an impact.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and portfolio to: [email protected] using "Application for Web Designer Position" as the subject of the email.
